Content:
## HistoryConfiguration.razor

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Components.Shared`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Components.Core`
**Location**: `Components/Shared/HistoryConfiguration.razor` + `HistoryConfiguration.razor.cs`

### Purpose
Blazor shared component that displays a MudBlazor dropdown (`MudSelect`) for configuring the chat history inclusion mode. Allows users to control how much of the conversation history is visible to the AI model.

### Component Markup
```razor
<MudSelect @bind-Value="Model.HistoryInclusion" Label="History Inclusion"
           Variant="Variant.Outlined" Dense="true"
           HelperText="Controls how much of the conversation's history is visible to the model."
           Required>
    <MudSelectItem Value="@HistoryInclusionMode.All">All</MudSelectItem>
    <MudSelectItem Value="@HistoryInclusionMode.LastTwo">Last 2 Iterations</MudSelectItem>
    <MudSelectItem Value="@HistoryInclusionMode.LastTen">Last 10 Iterations</MudSelectItem>
    <MudSelectItem Value="@HistoryInclusionMode.Instruct">Instruct (no history)</MudSelectItem>
</MudSelect>
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `Model` | `ChatConfiguration` | Yes | The chat configuration whose `HistoryInclusion` property will be updated |

### Code-Behind

```csharp
public partial class HistoryConfiguration
{
    [Parameter] public ChatConfiguration Model { get; set; } = default!;
}
```

### Behavior

1. **Binding**: Uses `@bind-Value="Model.HistoryInclusion"` for two-way binding directly to the `ChatConfiguration.HistoryInclusion` property.
2. **Options**: Displays four history inclusion modes:
   - `All` — Full conversation history is included
   - `Last 2 Iterations` — Only the last 2 back-and-forth exchanges
   - `Last 10 Iterations` — Only the last 10 back-and-forth exchanges
   - `Instruct (no history)` — No history; each message is treated as a standalone instruction

3. **Validation**: The select is marked `Required`.

### Dependencies
- `ChatConfiguration` — Chat configuration model with `HistoryInclusion` property
- `HistoryInclusionMode` — Enum defining the inclusion modes (defined in Cyrena.Core)
